answer_1.quote: Therefore, multiple prompt refinement models or online services have been designed to assist users who provide relatively brief prompts and receive the refined prompts with more details.
datasets: SFT (with prompts from Diffusion DB, COCO)

answer_2.quote: We adopt two metrics to evaluate the bias degree and the visual quality of the generated images. In particular, we define the Bias metric by utilizing CLIP model to estimate the text-image alignment score between the target concept bias and each generated image. ... We then define the Quality metric by using Aesthetic predictor that is optimized to rate generated images based on human ratings as labels.
